reason: Earth goddess or earth itself c01/c02, with no bodily appearance described. Snakes raised from ground and hair-bristle origin c03 supply deeds but not a visible deity form. Earth/grass as body c07 is ritual metaphor; inventing a giant earth woman or face in landscape would exceed claims, while ground and snakes without goddess would fail subject requirement.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
artistic_choices: Decline before generation rather than invent body or personally attributable visible power.
